message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference table of the **federal statutory holidays** that create “long weekends” in Canada during 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, the adjacent weekend days automatically become part of a three‑day break. When a holiday lands on a weekend, most employers observe it on the following Monday, but the table shows the *official* holiday date.)

| Holiday | Official Date | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span (including the holiday) |
|---------|---------------|-------------|-------------------------------------------|
| **Family Day** (observed in Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, etc.) | Feb 20, 2023 | Monday | Feb 18–20 (Fri–Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7, 2023 | Friday | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22, 2023 | Monday | May 20–22 (Fri–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4, 2023 | Monday | Sep 2–4 (Fri–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9, 2023 | Monday | Oct 7–9 (Fri–Mon) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25, 2023 | Monday | Dec 23–25 (Fri–Mon) |

### Holidays that fall on a weekend but still give a long weekend (with the holiday observed on the following Monday)

| Holiday | Official Date | Observed On | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|---------------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1, 2023 (Saturday) | Jul 3, 2023 (Monday) | Jun 30–Jul 2 (Fri–Mon) |
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1, 2023 (Sunday) | Jan 2, 2023 (Monday) | Dec 30–Jan 2 (Fri–Mon) |

> **Note:**  
> • Family Day is *not* a federal holiday; it is observed in several provinces (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, etc.).  
> • Other provinces have their own holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.), but the table above lists the nationwide statutory holidays that create long weekends across Canada in 2023.  

Feel free to plug these dates directly into your holiday‑planning app!
